text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's time, it's time! We finally get to see Admire Vega, T.M. Opera O, Narita Top Road, and Meisho Doto go head to head!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Doto really stepped up to be taking on the big three from last year's Classics. I'm so glad I'm here to see this all go down!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe Fan A
text_block_list.text: But Admire Vega will definitely win the autumn shield. She's been blasting through the competition! She's flawless!

text_block_list.name: Opera O Fan A
text_block_list.text: No way, it'll be Opera O for sure! She's got that inexplicable strength that'll definitely make her the top of her generation!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: …N-no way! Not a chance!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text: Top Road is gonna win today for sure! Without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the race beginning soon, Admire Vega's ready to go. I watch her take in a deep breath, and I suddenly have the urge to ask her something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, I've never really asked her this before.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. A little.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think… I've got a lot on my mind right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Up until now, all I could think about was winning to fulfill my duty. It was simple.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But now…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think about Opera O's endless vigor… and Doto's tenacity…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And Top Road's resolve.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think of everyone's desire to win… including my own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think about the excitement of heading into a race. And the fear just before it starts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's all… bouncing around in my head.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So, yeah… I'm feeling nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to tell her it's a good kind of tension, but I stop myself…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She should hold onto this feeling just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Official
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega! Please head to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …It's time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll be back after I win.
